licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean; every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation and the stage directions are left out. In bars 24–31 the print puts the three Ladies on one staff (the upper note is the First Lady's, the lower the Second and Third Ladies'; where three notes are printed (bars 29–31), each Lady has her own); each Lady has her own line here. Playback tempo from complete recordings: the median length of this section, about 1:44, from Haitink 1981, whose track starts at “Drei Knäbchen” (1:52), and Klemperer 1964, Böhm 1964, Christie 1995 and Abbado 2005, whose No. 5 tracks (6:44, 6:27, 5:50, 5:46) were given this section's share of the quintet in Haitink's recording (26.9%).
